value.answer: No single agreed winner, so my pick is the 2026 Kia Carnival Hybrid. The newest review I found calls it the best overall for most families, with 32 mpg combined and a 10-year/100,000-mile powertrain warranty. If you rack up a lot of miles, the Sienna is the smarter money pick. If you want something that drives most like a car, go with the Odyssey.
